authorship.scope: Original, independently authored spoken mathematics, exact worked variational and finite-element calculations, and non-spoken companions. Previously authored manuscripts retained.

prerequisites.reason: Positive quadratic forms and Hessians in finite dimensions.
Constrained directional derivatives and second-order tests.

recommended.reason: Introductory weak equations in a PDE survey.

background: Single-variable differentiation and integration by parts, multivariable quadratic forms, functions with fixed endpoint values.
readiness_checks: Can you compute the first variation of a squared-derivative energy directly from u+t v?

description: Examines directional derivatives of functionals, admissible perturbations, second variations, and when an energy minimizer really follows from stationarity.
